competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage and weakens the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Power and increases the enemy's chance to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with an 80% chance each. In addition, your Attack Bar increases by 10% per harmful effect granted on the enemy.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.
The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Per harmful effect granted on enemy

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an attack where the inflicted damage is increased by 40% for each harmful effect or beneficial effect of the enemy. Puts the enemy to sleep for 2 turns after the attack. Targets that have immunity against sleep will be inflicted with 50% more damage.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
Increases damage per debuff on the target
